Coram : ABHAY MANOHAR SAPRE*, DINESH MAHESHWARI
Rajasthan Value Added Tax Act, 2003: Schedule IV, Entry 155; Schedule V, Residuary Entry – Mobile Crane Wire Ropes – Tax rate applicable – Whether chargeable to tax at the rate of 4% under Entry 155 of Schedule IV or at the rate of 12.5% under the Residuary Entry Act – Revenue’s submission was that since the goods in question are not specified in any of the Entries in Schedule IV and Schedule V nor they are the parts of the Mobile Cranes, the only Entry under which they can be taxed is the Residuary Entry of Schedule V of the VAT Act –
Decision Date : 26-03-2019 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 3198/2019 | Disposal Nature : Dismissed | Bench : 2 Judges
